entities.summary: Joseph Casey Shaw is an American former basketball player who is an assistant coach for the Grand Canyon Antelopes of the Western Athletic Conference (WAC). Prior to this he was the head coach of the boys' varsity basketball team at Davidson Academy and before that an assistant coach for the Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team. Shaw played the center position. After a collegiate career at the University of Toledo, he was drafted 37th overall by the Philadelphia 76ers in the 1998 NBA draft.
